## To Do

### TODO-10001 - Add a to-do item

- **Status:** To Do
- **User story:** As a user, I can add a to-do item so that I can keep track of work I need to complete.
- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - A user can enter a non-empty title and add the item.
  - The new item appears in the to-do list as incomplete.
  - Blank or whitespace-only titles are rejected with a clear validation message.

### TODO-10002 - Complete a to-do item

- **Status:** To Do
- **User story:** As a user, I can mark a to-do item as complete so that I can track my progress.
- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - A user can mark an incomplete item as complete.
  - Completed items are visually distinguishable from incomplete items.
  - The completed state is preserved when the list is reloaded.

### TODO-10003 - Delete a to-do item

- **Status:** To Do
- **User story:** As a user, I can delete a to-do item so that I can remove work I no longer need to track.
- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - A user can delete an existing item.
  - The deleted item is removed from the list.
  - The deleted item does not return when the list is reloaded.
